name: System Health Dashboard
description: Check the health status of all services in the activity-system namespace

prompt.template: Check the health of the activity API at {{activityApiUrl}}/health and show the status
Check the health of the identity vessel at http://identity-vessel.activity-system.svc.cluster.local:8080/health
Check the health of the user vessel at http://user-vessel.activity-system.svc.cluster.local:8080/health
Create a visual summary of all service health statuses using badge components. Show each service with a success (green), warning (yellow), or error (red) badge based on their health check results.
